domain: Intersection of kernel-contract engineering and platform-consolidation: where consolidating duplicated scripts/wrappers changes runtime semantics — distinguishing load-bearing divergence from accidental copies before naming a canonical home
axioms: Every consumer-visible behavior must be explicit, versioned contract, never an accident of the current implementation (parent A)
Every duplicated procedure definition is a latent bug; the smallest consolidation that removes divergence beats grand unification (parent B)
Some duplication is load-bearing: the divergence between copies may BE the de-facto contract consumers depend on — the parents contradict here, and the contradiction is investigated, not resolved
A guard that watches the wrong signal (dead path, identical version string, stale registry) is blinder than the drift it guards
The executed copy and the edited copy are the two candidates for canonical; canonizing the one no consumer runs flips behavior fleet-wide
'Informational' text can have behavioral consumers via content hashes — canonizing it changes exit codes, not just prose
primitives: canonical-home declaration (which copy consumers actually execute)
reconciliation guard (sync test, marker grep, freshness registry) and the signal it actually watches
provenance marker / version witness (comment, machine stamp, doc citation)
overwrite-protection contract (SKIP semantics) vs re-attachment mechanism (hash allowlist, migration stamp)
content-hash behavioral consumer (orientation manifest, exit-code contract)
failure_mode: Single-parent findings are out of charter: anything consolidation alone or contract analysis alone would catch must be discarded — may under-report plain drift
Read-only probe: canonization paths designed but none executed, so the 5-step twin-canonization path is unvalidated in practice
Consumer census limited to runtime hooks; build-time/CI consumers of the core twin inferred from test-integration.sh only
Did not re-litigate settled clusters (lock, dispatch events, ship gate, publish state) — assumes their upheld readings as fact base
